title: Meteor: Cryptographically Secure Steganography for Realistic Distributions
why: Establishes cryptographic treatment of generative steganography when token entropy varies widely. Relevant to shared randomness, security definitions, and why ordinary arithmetic coding needs careful analysis. Includes historical mobile measurements.
caveat: Its guarantee is relative to the agreed generative model. Historical mobile experiments do not validate our current quantized 3B model or phone-to-desktop interoperability.
